methods.label: Meeting equation
methods.explanation: For a meeting problem, the sum of the distances equals the sum of the speeds multiplied by the time. Thus, \((30+20)t=100\), so \(t=2\).
methods.levelReason: The distance-speed-time relationship and a simple equation are within Grade 7.
